definition: The Linguatec Sprachtechnologien GmbH is a language technology provider, specialized in the field of machine translation, speech synthesis and speech recognition.
details: Linguatec was founded in Munich in 1996 and its headquarters are in Pasing. Linguatec has won the European Information Society Technologies Prize three times. On their website, they are now using the online service Voice Reader Web, so that the information can be read out in every language by means of a text-to-speech function.

explainer.lead: Linguatec Sprachtechnologien GmbH is a language technology provider specializing in machine translation, speech synthesis, and speech recognition. It matters as a long-standing Munich-based vendor with three European Information Society Technologies Prizes.

tiers.eli5: It is a company that builds tools for translating text and for turning speech into text and text into speech.
tiers.practitioner: Provides machine translation, speech synthesis, and speech recognition technology; its website uses Voice Reader Web to read information aloud in every language via text-to-speech.
